## What it is about

*The chapter is written in Spanish; original title: "Las élites tecnológicas: la inserción en marcos normativos y redes corporativas".*

The chapter studies the dual embeddedness of tech elites in the age of artificial intelligence: their institutional embeddedness in the frameworks that regulate AI, and their relational embeddedness in corporate networks.

It compares the regulatory models of the United States and the European Union and analyses the interlocking directorates network of the 21 largest technology companies. The result is a tension: regulation is split into two paradigms (the European one, based on risk of use, and the US one, based on computing capacity), yet the networks are integrated through transatlantic ties. Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet connect with European tech firms such as Accenture, Adyen and SAP. This divergence between fragmented institutions and integrated networks calls into question whether national frameworks can constrain elites that operate transnationally.
